theorems.name: Submission.whitney_jet_gluing_c1
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : Set (Rn n)) (h : Rn n → ℝ) (ν : Rn n → Rn n) (ι : Type) (φ : ι → Rn n → ℝ) (p : ι → Rn n) (C M : ℝ) (g : Rn n → ℝ), IsClosed A → ContinuousOn ν A → (∀ K ⊆ A, IsCompact K → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ A, 0 < ‖y - x‖ → ‖y - x‖ < δ → |h y - h x - inner ℝ (ν x) (y - x)| ≤ ε * ‖y - x‖) → 0 ≤ C → 0 ≤ M → (∀ i, p i ∈ A) → (∀ i, ∀ x ∉ A, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (φ i) x) → (∀ i, ∀ x ∉ A, 0 ≤ φ i x) → (∀ x ∉ A, ∃ s : Finset ι, ∃ V ∈ 𝓝 x, ∀ i ∉ s, ∀ y ∈ V, φ i y = 0) → (∀ x ∉ A, ∑ᶠ i, φ i x = 1) → (∀ i, ∀ x ∉ A, φ i x ≠ 0 → ‖x - p i‖ ≤ C * Metric.infDist x A) → (∀ x ∉ A, Metric.infDist x A ≤ 1 → ∑ᶠ i, ‖fderiv ℝ (φ i) x‖ ≤ M / Metric.infDist x A) → (∀ x ∈ A, g x = h x) → (∀ x ∉ A, g x = ∑ᶠ i, φ i x * (h (p i) + inner ℝ (ν (p i)) (x - p i))) → ContDiff ℝ 1 g ∧ ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ v, fderiv ℝ g x v = inner ℝ (ν x) v
